articles.title: Capital One bank cites money-laundering probe to justify closing Trump Organization accounts

articles.title: Two firefighting helicopters collide near Athens as Greece confronts multiple blazes

articles.title: Hungary: Successive heatwaves drain Danube river used to cool nuclear plant
articles.description: Prolonged drought and extreme heat across Europe have also triggered an energy crisis. For the first time ever, Hungary announced the shutdown of the country’s only nuclear power plant, after water levels in the Danube fell to a record low. Peter O’Brien explains.

The attack came less than a week before President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella is due to take office. He has said he plans to end the current administration’s peace negotiations with various armed groups. Morgan Ayre reports.

articles.title: France: Most of 224,000 evacuees allowed to return home after devastating fires
